Then he returned to the tower, lit the lamp, and watched its beam cross the dark water, carrying the truth farther than any bottle could.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一台暂时调低声音的机器。末班公交车驶过空旷的路口，尾灯在湿漉漉的柏油上拖出红线。便利店的白光里，店员打着哈欠补货；环卫工把落叶拢成一小堆。远处塔吊停在灰蓝色天幕中，几扇窗仍亮着，像没说完的话。豆浆铺升起第一缕蒸汽，风穿过高楼，夜色正沿着屋檐，一寸一寸退向黎明。","w03":"- Recursion is when a way of solving a problem uses a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It always needs a stopping point, called the base case, so it does not go on forever.\n- For example, to count down from 5, say 5 and then count down from 4, until you reach 0 and stop."}
